description.summary: This table details coverage exclusions for the Adira Kesef apartment insurance policy. It lists events that are *not* covered, helping policyholders understand the scope of their insurance.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת אדירה כסף אינה מכסה נזקים הנגרמים משחיקה טבעית, לחות, חלודה או קורוזיה. כמו כן, נזקים כתוצאה מתנועת קרקע או תכנון לקוי בבנייה אינם כלולים בכיסוי. הפוליסה אינה מכסה גם נזקים הנגרמים מניקיון, חידוש, תיקון או צביעה.
notable_values: Damage from gradual deterioration: not covered

טבלה: אדירה כסף - כיסויים
This table details coverage exclusions for the Adira Kesef apartment insurance policy. It lists events that are *not* covered, helping policyholders understand the scope of their insurance.
ממדים: Type of damage/event, Coverage exclusion details

9.1 The insured event is covered or could be covered in this chapter (apartment insurance).
9.2 Direct damages of mechanical breakdown or of electrical or electronic breakdown.
9.3
Scratching or cracking of various coatings or damage to the building cladding.
9.4 Moths, other insects, worms, rodents, gradual deterioration, wear and tear, moisture, rust and corrosion processes, atmospheric or climatic factors having a gradual effect.
9.5 Damage resulting from soil movement and/or subsidence.
9.6 Damage resulting from defective planning and/or construction and/or defective workmanship.
9.7 Damage due to cleaning, renewal, repair or painting processes.
